title: Hitler and the Magenta crash; Nazi saucer tests

tellings.quote: From reports that Hitler knew about the 1933 Magenta Crash to rumors of Nazi saucer tests in modern-day Czechoslovakia

plain: Michels mentions reports that Adolf Hitler knew about the Magenta crash, a supposed 1933 crash of an unknown craft at Magenta in Italy, and he mentions rumours that the Nazis tested flying saucers in what is now the Czech Republic or Slovakia, in the years up to 1949. He brings both up in passing, calling one "reports" and the other "rumors", without naming a source. If true, it would mean Europe's governments were chasing such craft years before the American UFO stories began.
